myths.title: Name and Meaning
myths.text: The name means "The Gatherer (from τίθημι)" and reflects the figure's role in the tradition.

lore.syncretism: Thēseus appears within the Greek tradition and has influenced later retellings, artistic depictions, and scholarly study. The Unicode restoration preserves the name's distinctive orthography for contemporary use.
lore.culturalLegacy: Thēseus continues to appear in scholarship, art, and popular reception as a significant figure of the Greek tradition. Restoring the name in Unicode returns the original marks that ASCII removes.
lore.extendedMeditation: Thēseus embodies heroism, athens, labours in the Greek imagination. The name's restoration is not merely cosmetic: it recovers the stress, length, and script that make the figure recognizable in the source tradition.
lore.archaeology: Thēseus is attested in the textual and iconographic record of the Greek tradition.
